title: Redis 8.10.2
body:
### Security fixes

* [Fix ACL key permissions not being rechecked at EXEC time #15673](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/15673) Commands queued in a transaction could still access keys whose ACL permissions were revoked before the transaction was executed
* [Make an unauthenticated cluster bus port an explicit choice #15722](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/15722) The cluster bus protocol has no authentication of its own unless `tls-cluster` is enabled, so any host able to reach a node's bus port could join the cluster and threaten it. A cluster node now warns at startup when its bus port is left unauthenticated, and the new `cluster-bus-port-protected-mode` option (default `no`) makes refusing to run in that state an explicit choice: set it to `yes` and the node starts only when `tls-cluster` authenticates the bus
* TimeSeries: Prevented Redis from crashing when adding samples to a compressed Time Series key restored from a malformed RDB payload
* RedisSearch: KNN queries on indexes with very long vector field names could cause the server to crash
* Vector Sets: Deeply nested JSON used in Vector Set queries could cause the server to crash

---

> [!NOTE]
> **High Risk**
> Security fixes touch ACL enforcement at EXEC, cluster networking defaults, and crash-prone JSON parsing; cluster config changes can block startup if misconfigured with protected mode enabled.
> 
> **Overview**
> **Redis 8.10.2** is a security-focused patch release (version bump, release notes, RediSearch module pin to v8.10.1).
> 
> **ACL / transactions:** `ACLCheckAllPerm` now takes the `pendingCommand` for the command being checked, so `EXEC` re-validates **key** permissions against each queued command’s argv (not `EXEC`’s keys). Related refactors keep cached key extraction tied to the right pending command; module command filters re-run `preprocessCommand` when filters mutate argv.
> 
> **Cluster bus:** New `cluster-bus-port-protected-mode` (default `no`) logs a startup warning when the bus is unauthenticated without `tls-cluster`, and with `yes` refuses to start or `CONFIG SET` into that state unless TLS protects the bus or protection is explicitly waived. Docs (`TLS.md`, `redis.conf`) and extensive cluster/TLS tests cover this; CI and test defaults waive protection for non-TLS runs.
> 
> **Vector Sets:** The in-tree `fastjson` parser caps array nesting recursion (1000) to avoid stack overflow on malicious deeply nested JSON, with new stress tests.
> 
> **Other:** `create-cluster` and external cluster workflow pass `cluster-bus-port-protected-mode no` where needed.
>
